  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "explanation":"stolen_card",
      "likelihood":"medium",
      "reasoning":"The failed identity and issuer-authentication check supports unauthorized payment use, but does not identify which component failed. CVV failure alone does not establish stolen-card evidence under R03 because the countries match."
    },
    {
      "explanation":"household",
      "likelihood":"medium",
      "reasoning":"Multiple accounts shipping to the current home address plausibly reflect household sharing. A legitimate customer could fail verification, but household sharing neither qualifies for the address exception here nor overrides the failed check."

  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R08 holds because three accounts used the shipping address. Although it is the current home address, its registration is too recent for the household exception. Linkage is the only adverse family; no other rule condition holds, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Household sharing is plausible, while CVV failure without geographic mismatch does not establish R03. The required id_check failed, so §5.3(b) overrides the ordinary §6.6(b) hold path and makes escalation standard; decline is also permitted. Recommend escalation before shipment, with linked-account scope limited by §2.5. No further check is needed to decide this order."
